note: long enough for the whole crew

dish.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mix the pork and beef mince with the egg, parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, salt and pepper and roll into 16 meatballs.
Bake the meatballs on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes.
Simmer the passata with the oregano, add the meatballs and simmer for 15 minutes.
Split the long rolls, pack in the meatballs and sauce and lay the provolone on top.
Grill for 2 to 3 minutes until the cheese has melted.

note: dumplings and fried rice eaten out of the boxes on the desk

dish.make_ahead: Cook the rice a day ahead and chill

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice the day before, spread it on a tray and chill overnight.
Slice the lap cheong and spring onions and beat the eggs.
Heat a wok until smoking with half the oil, scramble the eggs, then add the lap cheong, rice and 2 tbsp soy sauce and toss for 4 minutes until hot. Stir through the spring onions.
Fry the frozen pork dumplings in the rest of the oil in a frying pan for 2 minutes until the bases brown, add the water, cover and steam for 6 minutes.
Serve out of takeaway boxes with the rest of the soy sauce on the side.

note: Grilled bratwurst in rolls with beer onions, sauerkraut and hot mustard

steps.text: Put the bratwurst in a wide pan with the sliced onions, the cans of lager and the butter.
Simmer gently for 15 minutes.
Lift out the sausages and grill on a hot barbecue for 6 to 8 minutes until charred.
Boil the onions in the beer until most of it evaporates and they're sticky.
Toast the long rolls and fill with a bratwurst, onions, warmed sauerkraut and hot mustard.

note: Beef shin, carrots, potatoes and pearl barley simmered 3 hours

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes.
Add the vegetables, barley, stock and thyme.
Simmer until thick.
Serve with bread.

film: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore (2022)
note: Panko crumbed pork loin fried in butter, warm potato salad

steps.text: Pound the pork thin and crumb in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Boil the potatoes, then slice and toss warm with vinegar, oil and salt.
Boil.
Fry the schnitzel in butter until golden on both sides.
Serve with lemon wedges.

note: Beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato soup in beef stock, with dill

steps.text: Prepare the vegetables.
Simmer the vegetables in the stock until tender.
Season with dill and vinegar.
Serve in bowls with sour cream.

note: room service for the crew

ingredients.item: rib eye steak, in four pieces

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry the frites in oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Fry again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Pat the steaks dry and season. Sear in a heavy pan on both sides, then rest.
Add the pepper to the pan, then carefully add the brandy away from the flame. Add the stock and reduce.
Add the cream and simmer. Serve the steaks with the sauce and frites.

note: Chicken breast stuffed with spinach and ricotta, mushroom cream sauce, potato gratin

dish.make_ahead: Gratin up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Wilt the spinach, squeeze dry and mix with the ricotta. Cut a pocket in each chicken breast and fill.
Layer the potatoes in a dish with most of the cream and bake at 180C.
Sear the chicken in oil, then roast at 200C alongside for the last 20 minutes.
Cook the mushrooms in butter, add the remaining cream and simmer until thick. Serve over the chicken.

note: Buttermilk fried chicken, mashed potato, pepper gravy and chilli honey

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Combine the chicken, buttermilk, salt and hot sauce in a bowl.
Soak in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Toss the chicken in flour mixed with paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Fry at 165C in batches until golden and cooked through.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Make gravy with butter, flour, milk and lots of pepper.
Warm the honey with chilli flakes to drizzle over the chicken.
Soak the dried chillies in hot water for 15 minutes.
Blitz the chillies with the crushed tomatoes and garlic and simmer 10 minutes into a sauce.
Poach the chicken thighs in simmering water for 20 minutes, then shred.
Roll the chicken in the corn tortillas and pack into a baking dish.
Cover with the sauce and cheddar and bake at 190C for 20 minutes.
Serve with the sour cream.

note: Thin crust pizza with Italian sausage, mushrooms, mozzarella and garlic tomato sauce

steps.text: Heat a pizza steel in the oven at its maximum.
Mix the tomatoes with crushed garlic and oregano. Squeeze the sausage from its skins, slice the mushrooms and grate the mozzarella.
Stretch the dough into two thin bases and top with sauce, sausage, mushrooms and cheese.
Bake on the hot steel at maximum heat.

film: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three (1974)
note: Garber's desk lunch

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, wrapped and chilled

steps.text: Split the rolls and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer with turkey, Swiss cheese, lettuce and tomato. Season.
Close, wrap tightly in paper and cut in half.

note: Steamed pastrami, mustard and melted Swiss on rye, dill pickle on the side

steps.text: Steam the pastrami until glossy.
Pile onto rye spread with mustard and top with Swiss cheese.
Grill until the cheese melts. Serve each with a dill pickle.

note: Garlic, rosemary and paprika lamb shoulder roasted 5 hours, mint parsley salad

steps.text: Rub the lamb with crushed garlic, rosemary and paprika.
Roast covered at 150C until it pulls apart.
Rest and shred the lamb.
Toss mint and parsley into a salad.
Serve with warm flatbreads and the salad.

note: Garlic rosemary lamb chops grilled hot, roasted red peppers, garlic yogurt

steps.text: Crush 4 of the garlic cloves and mix with the chopped rosemary, lemon juice and zest and the oil. Rub over the lamb.
Cover and marinate in the fridge overnight.
Roast the capsicums at 220C until blistered, then peel and slice.
Grill the lamb hot until charred outside and pink inside.
Crush the last garlic clove into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt. Serve with the lamb and capsicums.

note: Cumin braised shredded beef with rice, black beans and fried green plantain

dish.n: Shredded beef, rice, beans and plantains
dish.make_ahead: Beef braise up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Braise the beef with the tomatoes, onions and cumin for 3 hours, then shred.
Cook the rice and warm the black beans.
Fry the plantain slices until golden.
Fry the eggs.
Serve it all on one plate.

film: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle (2004)
note: Thin beef patties steamed over onions with cheddar and pickles

steps.text: Press the beef mince thin across a lined tray and cut into squares.
Spread the finely diced onions in a hot pan with a splash of water, lay the patties on top, cover and steam 3 minutes.
Add cheese and serve in the small soft buns with pickles.

note: Italian sausage and mushroom tomato sauce over thick polenta

steps.text: Squeeze the sausages from their skins and slice the mushrooms.
Brown the sausage meat in oil, add the mushrooms and tomatoes and simmer.
Cook the polenta in the boiling water, stirring, until thick.
Beat in the butter and parmesan.
Spoon the ragu over the polenta.

note: Beef chuck braised in red wine with carrots, celery and potatoes

dish.n: Fred Gailey's New York pot roast
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Sear the beef all over.
Add the onion, carrots, celery, wine and enough water to come halfway.
Cover and braise at 160C.
Add the potatoes for the last hour.
Slice and serve with the juices.

note: Seared eye fillet in red wine jus, with creamy potato gratin

dish.n: Business dinner eye fillet and red wine jus

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin and prepare the shallots and beans.
Layer the potatoes with the cream, crushed garlic and salt, and bake at 160C.
Sear the eye fillet on all sides, then roast at 200C to 54C inside.
Rest the beef. Chop the shallots and soften in the pan.
Add the wine and reduce by half, then add the stock and reduce until glossy. Whisk in some of the butter.
Steam the beans and toss with the remaining butter.

note: Buttermilk brined chicken, double dredged and fried in cast iron

steps.text: Brine the chicken overnight in the buttermilk and hot sauce.
Season the flour with paprika and salt and dredge the chicken twice.
Fry in a cast iron pan at 165C in batches until 74C at the bone.
Drain on a rack.

note: Twice-fried pork with capsicum and pineapple in sweet and sour sauce

dish.n: Wedding banquet crispy sweet and sour pork
dish.make_ahead: Eat straight away for the best crunch

steps.text: Slice the pork thinly, season and toss in egg white, then potato starch.
Fry at 180C, then rest.
Fry again until very crisp.
Julienne the carrot and slice the capsicum and garlic.
Stir-fry the capsicum, carrot, garlic and pineapple.
Mix the rice vinegar, sugar, tomato sauce, soy and cornflour with water.
Add the sauce and bubble until glossy.
Cook the rice.
Toss in the pork and serve with rice.

note: Grilled franks with slow cooked onions, mustard and sweet relish in toasted buns

steps.text: Slice the onions and cook slowly in the butter.
Score the franks and grill over coals until blistered.
Toast the buns and fill with franks, onions, mustard and sweet relish.

film: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit (2005)
note: Zucchini filled with lamb and tomato, topped with cheddar and baked

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Halve the zucchini and scoop out the middles, chopping the flesh.
Fry the onion and lamb mince in the oil with the zucchini flesh, tomatoes and thyme until thick.
Fill the zucchini shells and cover with cheddar.
Bake until tender and bubbling.

note: Sliced grilled chicken thighs, coconut black rice, quick pickled carrot and cabbage

dish.n: Chicken, coconut black rice and pickles

steps.text: Shred the carrot and cabbage and pickle them in the vinegar and sugar for 30 minutes.
Simmer the black rice in the coconut milk plus a splash of water until tender.
Grill the chicken thighs until cooked through, then slice.
Serve the chicken on the purple rice with the pickles.

note: Beef goulash with sweet paprika over buttered egg noodles, sour cream on top

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in a heavy pot.
Add the onions and paprika and stir until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and enough water to cover.
Cover and simmer gently, stirring now and then, until the beef is very tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the noodles and toss with butter.
Serve the goulash over the noodles with sour cream.

note: Lamb braised with ras el hanout, saffron, apricots and chickpeas, over couscous

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the lamb in batches.
Soften the onions with ras el hanout and saffron.
Add the water, apricots and chickpeas.
Cook covered until the lamb is tender.
Prepare the couscous and serve under the tagine with herbs.

note: Steamed pastrami piled on rye with spicy mustard, potato salad on the side

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, cool and toss with the mayo, celery and dill.
Steam the pastrami for 10 minutes until soft.
Pile high on the rye spread with spicy mustard.
Serve each sandwich with a whole dill pickle.

note: Lamb shoulder braised 3 hours with ras el hanout, dates and preserved lemon, couscous

steps.text: Brown the lamb in batches and soften the onions.
Add the ras el hanout, stock, dates and sliced preserved lemon.
Cover and cook at 160C until the lamb is tender.
Prepare the couscous and toast the almonds.
Serve the tagine over couscous with the almonds.

note: Beef and pork meatballs simmered in tomato and basil, over spaghetti

steps.text: Mix the minces with parmesan and egg, roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in oil.
Add the tomatoes and torn basil and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti and pile the meatballs on top.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl (2003)
note: Charcoal-grilled scotch bonnet jerk chicken legs with coconut rice and beans

steps.text: Blitz the chillies, allspice, thyme, spring onions, garlic and lime juice into a paste.
Coat the chicken and marinate overnight in the fridge.
Grill slowly over coals, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Cook the rice with the kidney beans, coconut milk and a little water.
Serve the chicken on the rice.

note: Chicken thighs braised with mushrooms, thyme, white wine and cream, rice pilaf

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the mushrooms, thyme and wine and braise.
Cook the rice with the butter and stock for a pilaf.
Stir the cream into the chicken and serve with the pilaf.

note: Beef meatloaf with a brown sugar tomato glaze

steps.text: Mix the mince with the onion, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and press into a loaf tin.
Spread with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter, and make a gravy from the stock and flour.
Serve thick slices with mash and gravy.

note: Roast beef eye fillet, creamy potato bake and a rich pan gravy

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly and layer with cream and garlic in a dish.
Bake the potatoes at 180C.
Sear the beef all over in the oil.
Roast the beef at 200C alongside the potatoes until medium-rare.
Rest the beef.
Deglaze the pan with beef stock and reduce until glossy.
Cook the green beans.
Serve by candlelight on a boat.

note: Fish, mussel and prawn stew with saffron, fennel and tomato, rouille toast

steps.text: Chop the fennel, leek, onion and garlic.
Soften in oil with the saffron, orange peel and tomatoes.
Add the fish stock and simmer.
Add the fish, then the mussels and prawns, and cook until the shells open.
Toast sliced baguette and serve with rouille.

note: big plate, no talking about the panic attacks

dish.make_ahead: Crumb up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Dust the veal in flour, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry 2 minutes a side until golden.
Warm about half the passata, top each cutlet with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan and grill until bubbling.
Cook the spaghetti and toss in the rest of the passata, heated.

note: Seared sirloin, cracked pepper cream sauce, thin fries

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, fry chips fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Fry the fries twice until crisp.
Sear the steaks to your liking and rest.
Toast the cracked peppercorns in the pan, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Serve with the fries and a green salad.

note: Grilled bratwurst, sauerkraut with apple and caraway, buttered potatoes

steps.text: Simmer the sauerkraut with the wine, apple and caraway.
Grill the bratwurst slowly until browned.
Boil the potatoes until tender and toss in butter.
Serve together.

note: Corned beef, sauerkraut and Swiss cheese on buttered rye, with dressing

steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce and chopped pickle for the dressing.
Layer the rye with corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese and dressing.
Butter the outsides.
Grill in a pan until golden and melting.
Cut in half to serve.

note: Marinated pork shoulder in warm pitas with tzatziki, tomato and red onion

steps.text: Mix the garlic, oregano, lemon juice and oil and marinate the pork
Griddle the pork, turning once, and slice thin
Mix the yoghurt with the cucumber and garlic for tzatziki
Warm the pitas and wrap the pork with tzatziki, tomato and red onion

note: Charred kielbasa in a roll with chips, barbecue sauce and slaw

dish.n: Cleveland Polish boy with fries and slaw

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar for the slaw.
Score the kielbasa and grill, turning, until charred.
Split the rolls, lay a kielbasa in each, pile on hot chips, drizzle with barbecue sauce and top with slaw.

note: Thin crust pizza with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms

steps.text: Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Spread with tomatoes and top with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms.
Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Rewatch the tape.

note: Beef and ale pie with a puff pastry lid, chips and crushed peas

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches, then soften the onions
Stir in the flour first, then add the ale and stock, cover and braise at 160C
Cool slightly, tip into a pie dish and cover with puff pastry
Bake at 200C
Cut the potatoes into chips and fry them twice in the vegetable oil
Cook and crush the peas

note: Yoghurt marinated chicken layered with basmati and crisp fried onions

dish.make_ahead: Marinate and assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, garam masala and salt, then marinate in the fridge.
Slice the onions and fry in the oil until crisp.
Par-cook the basmati for a few minutes and drain.
Layer the chicken, rice and onions in a heavy pot and drizzle with saffron soaked in the warm milk.
Seal the pot and bake at 170C.

note: Butterflied lamb leg grilled with harissa, sliced over couscous with garlic yogurt

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

ingredients.item: garlic clove, crushed, for the sauce

steps.text: Rub the lamb with the harissa, garlic and cumin.
Marinate for 2 hours.
Grill over high heat until charred outside and pink inside.
Rest for 15 minutes. Steep the couscous and mix the garlic into the yoghurt. Slice the lamb over couscous with the sauce.

note: Beef chuck stewed with onions, carrots, stout and potatoes

steps.text: Chop the onions, carrots and potatoes.
Brown the beef in oil.
Add the onions, carrots, stout and water to cover and simmer.
Add the potatoes and simmer until thick.
Serve in bowls with crusty bread.

note: Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and garlic, baked in foil

dish.n: Foil baked trout with lemon and dill

steps.text: Stuff the trout with lemon slices, dill and garlic
Dot with some of the butter and wrap each in foil
Bake at 200C and open at the table
Boil the potatoes until tender
Toss with the remaining butter

note: Oven-baked spicy tomato rice topped with grilled chicken thighs

steps.text: Blitz the tomatoes, capsicum, onion and chilli.
Fry the blended sauce in oil until deep red.
Stir in the rice, stock and thyme, cover and bake at 170C.
Grill the chicken thighs until charred and cooked through.
Lay the chicken on the rice and serve.

film: Danger Close: The Battle of Long Tan (2019)
note: Slow-cooked beef, cannellini beans and paprika over buttered rice

dish.n: D Company field kitchen beef and beans
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the chuck, onion, capsicum and garlic.
Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the onion, garlic and capsicum and cook.
Stir in the paprika, cumin, crushed tomatoes, stock and drained cannellini beans.
Cover and simmer until tender.
Cook the rice and stir through the butter.
Serve with sliced pickled chilli.

note: a long hot day on the block

steps.text: Toss the drumsticks with salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Roast at 200C until starting to colour.
Brush with barbecue sauce and grill or roast, basting twice, until sticky.
Boil the corn for 6 minutes and roll in the butter.
Serve the chicken with the corn and potato salad.

note: Lemon chicken, grilled corn, cos, tomato and avocado, buttermilk dressing

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the oil, lemon zest and juice, garlic and oregano.
Grill the chicken, turning once, then rest and slice.
Grill the corn and cut off the kernels.
Whisk the buttermilk, mayonnaise, chives and dill into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber and avocado, then top with chicken and corn and drizzle with dressing.

note: Beef chuck braised with onion, carrot, celery, tomato paste and red wine

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the wine, stock and thyme and return the beef.
Braise in a 150C oven.
Boil the potatoes towards the end of braising and mash with butter. Serve the stew on top.

note: Whole trout pan-fried crisp, brown butter and flaked almonds

steps.text: Dust the trout in flour and season.
Fry two at a time in butter until crisp on both sides.
Brown the sauce butter with the almonds, add lemon juice and chopped parsley.
Spoon over the fish.

note: Five spice duck dried overnight and roasted, plum sauce and jasmine rice

dish.n: Ricky Tan's Hong Kong roast goose

steps.text: Rub the cavity with five spice and salt, then leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry the skin.
Brush with honey loosened with hot water.
Roast at 180C, brushing again twice.
Rest the duck, cook the rice and chop through the bone.
Serve with plum sauce and rice.

note: Potato and toasted hazelnut soup with celery

steps.text: Toast the hazelnuts and rub off the skins.
Soften the onion and celery in the butter.
Add the potatoes, most of the hazelnuts and the stock.
Simmer until the potato is soft.
Blend smooth and stir in the cream.
Top with crushed hazelnuts and chives.

note: South African spiced beef bake with curry, chutney and an egg custard topping

steps.text: Soak the bread in some of the milk and chop the onion.
Fry the mince with the onion, curry powder and turmeric.
Stir in the chutney and the squeezed bread, then press into a dish.
Beat the eggs with the remaining milk and pour over. Add bay leaves and bake at 180C.

note: Wok-fried rice with chicken, garlic and red chilli

steps.text: Dice the chicken, crush the garlic, chop the chillies and slice the cucumber.
Stir fry the chicken with the garlic and chilli in a very hot wok.
Add the cold rice and kecap manis and toss until smoky.
Fry the eggs and serve on top with cucumber slices.

note: the long walk to court

steps.text: Fry the onion on a hot griddle until soft.
Add the mince and chop it up with a spatula as it browns, seasoning well.
Lay the cheese on top and chop through until melted.
Toast the rolls. Pile in the meat with lettuce, tomato and mayo.

note: Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and egg noodles

steps.text: Put the chicken, carrots, celery and onion in a pot with the water.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked.
Shred the chicken back into the pot.
Add the noodles and cook.
Finish with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

note: Rosemary rump steaks grilled over coals, potatoes baked in foil

steps.text: Wrap each potato with a knob of butter in foil.
Bake in the coals.
Rub the steaks with salt, pepper and chopped rosemary.
Grill over hot coals on both sides.
Rest on a board.

note: Grilled Italian sausages with soft peppers and onions in crusty rolls, hot mustard

steps.text: Grill the sausages slowly until browned all over.
Slice the capsicums and onions.
In the same pan, soften the capsicums and onions in the fat with the oregano.
Pile the sausages and peppers into the rolls and add hot mustard.

note: Sage thyme butter turkey, mash, green beans and cranberry sauce

steps.text: Mash some of the butter with chopped sage, thyme and one garlic clove and push it under the skin of the turkey.
Roast at 180C.
Rest the turkey.
Boil the potatoes and mash with some of the butter and the milk.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer to a gravy.
Blanch the beans and toss with garlic butter. Serve with cranberry sauce.

note: Chicken in coconut green curry sauce served with jasmine rice

steps.text: Cook the jasmine rice.
Fry the green curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the sliced chicken thigh and stir 3 minutes.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, the stock, the torn makrut lime leaves, the fish sauce and the palm sugar.
Simmer 12 minutes, adding the snake beans for the last 5.
Stir in Thai basil and serve with rice and sliced chilli.

note: Crispy pork in a sweet and sour sauce with capsicum and pineapple

dish.n: Sweet and sour pork with rice

steps.text: Cube the pork, toss with the soy sauce, then coat in most of the cornflour. Slice the capsicum.
Cook the rice by the absorption method and keep warm.
Fry the pork in batches in oil at 180C until crisp, then drain.
Stir fry the capsicum and pineapple in a wok, add the vinegar, sugar, tomato sauce and water, and thicken with the last of the cornflour mixed with a little water.
Toss the pork through the sauce and serve with the rice.

note: Paprika-rubbed pork ribs baked slow and glazed with molasses tomato sauce

steps.text: Rub the ribs with paprika, brown sugar, crushed garlic and cayenne.
Wrap in foil.
Bake at 150C until tender.
Simmer the tomato sauce with molasses.
Unwrap, brush on the glaze and glaze under the grill.

film: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (2005)
note: Five spice roast duck brushed with an orange, honey and soy glaze

steps.text: Prick the duck all over and rub with salt and five spice. Set on a rack in a tray.
Roast at 180C for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Meanwhile simmer the orange juice, honey, soy and star anise until syrupy.
Brush the glaze over the duck and roast another 15 minutes. Steam the rice.
Rest the duck for 10 minutes, carve and serve over rice with the rest of the glaze.

note: Scrambled eggs, crisp potato, chorizo and cheddar in flour tortillas, fresh salsa

steps.text: Dice and fry the potatoes until crisp, then add the diced chorizo.
Make a fresh salsa of diced tomatoes and onion.
Softly scramble the eggs.
Fill the tortillas with the eggs, potato, chorizo, cheddar and salsa.
Roll and toast in a dry pan.

note: Spiced lamb skewers on flatbread with garlic yoghurt and chilli butter

dish.make_ahead: Mix up to 1 day ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Mix the lamb mince with grated onion, crushed garlic, cumin, sumac, paprika, parsley and salt.
Shape onto skewers.
Grill, turning.
Mix the yoghurt with crushed garlic.
Toss the diced tomatoes and sliced red onion with parsley and lemon.
Melt the butter with chilli flakes.
Serve on warm flatbread with yoghurt, salad and chilli butter.

note: Chicken thighs, chorizo, capsicum and saffron rice

steps.text: Slice the chorizo and capsicum.
Brown the chicken and chorizo in a wide pan.
Add the capsicum, rice and saffron, then pour in the hot stock.
Simmer without stirring until the bottom crisps.
Serve with lemon wedges.
